exams.name: Commission examination
exams.notes: Commission prepares and gives, or approves preparation and giving of, an examination covering subjects required for the degree of doctor of medicine. Commission may waive any prerequisite to licensure not set forth in statute.
exams.quote: applicants for licensure must successfully complete an examination administered by the commission to determine their professional qualifications

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners examination
exams.notes: Passing NBME exam may qualify applicant for license without examination in lieu of state exam, at commission discretion.
exams.quote: an applicant who has satisfactorily passed examinations given by the national board of medical examiners may, in the discretion of the commission, be granted a license without examination

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Required for foreign medical graduates under RCW 18.71.051 and for interstate compact (IMLC) eligibility under RCW 18.71B.020.
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States medical licensing examination (USMLE) or the comprehensive osteopathic medical licensing examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts

exams.name: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) examination
exams.notes: Required for foreign medical graduates applying under RCW 18.71.051.
exams.quote: That he or she has satisfactorily passed the examination given by the educational council for foreign medical graduates or has met the requirements in lieu thereof as set forth in rules adopted by the commission

required.quote: The commission may establish rules governing mandatory continuing education requirements which shall be met by physicians applying for renewal of licenses.

hours_per_period.quote: The number of hours of continuing education for a physician holding a retired active license shall not exceed fifty hours per year.

topical_requirements.quote: mandatory continuing education requirements may be met in part by physicians showing evidence of the completion of approved activities relating to professional liability risk management

available.quote: Any applicant who meets the requirements of RCW 18.71.050 and has been licensed under the laws of another state, territory, or possession of the United States, or of any province of Canada ... may, in the discretion of the commission, be granted a license without examination

requirements.value: Applicant must meet all requirements of RCW 18.71.050, file a certified copy of the out-of-state license, and show that the other state's standards, eligibility requirements, and examinations are at least equal in all respects to those of Washington.
requirements.quote: the applicant must file with the commission a copy of the license certified by the proper authorities of the issuing state to be a full, true copy thereof, and must show that the standards, eligibility requirements, and examinations of that state are at least equal in all respects to those of this state

exists.quote: The Washington medical commission is established, consisting of thirteen individuals licensed to practice medicine in the state of Washington under this chapter, two individuals who are licensed in the state of Washington as physician assistants under chapter 18.71A RCW, and six individuals who are members of the public.

national_certification.quote: "Maintenance of certification" means the satisfactory participation in a formal recertification program to maintain board certification after initial certification from the American board of medical specialties or other accrediting organization recognized by the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the person's profession, whether the act constitutes a crime or not.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining a license or in reinstatement thereof.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining a license or in reinstatement thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: All advertising which is false, fraudulent, or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising which is false, fraudulent, or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice which results in injury to a patient or which creates an unreasonable risk that a patient may be harmed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice which results in injury to a patient or which creates an unreasonable risk that a patient may be harmed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of the individual's license to practice any health care profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of the individual's license to practice any health care profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Possession, use, prescription for use, or distribution of controlled substances or legend drugs other than for legitimate or therapeutic purposes, or violation of any drug law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The possession, use, prescription for use, or distribution of controlled substances or legend drugs in any way other than for legitimate or therapeutic purposes, diversion of controlled substances or legend drugs, the violation of any drug law, or prescribing controlled substances for oneself

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any state or federal statute or administrative rule regulating the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any state or federal statute or administrative rule regulating the profession in question, including any statute or rule defining or establishing standards of patient care or professional conduct or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with the disciplining authority by not furnishing documents, not providing explanations, not responding to subpoenas, or not providing access for practice reviews.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with the disciplining authority by: (a) Not furnishing any papers, documents, records, or other items

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplining authority or a stipulation for informal disposition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplining authority or a stipulation for informal disposition entered into with the disciplining authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice when a license is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice when a license is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of rules established by any health agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violations of rules established by any health agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or fraud in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or fraud in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise auxiliary staff to the extent that the consumer's health or safety is at risk.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to adequately supervise auxiliary staff to the extent that the consumer's health or safety is at risk

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a profession involving contact with the public while suffering from a contagious or infectious disease involving serious risk to public health.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a profession involving contact with the public while suffering from a contagious or infectious disease involving serious risk to public health

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion for personal gain of any unnecessary or inefficacious drug, device, treatment, procedure, or service.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion for personal gain of any unnecessary or inefficacious drug, device, treatment, procedure, or service

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the person's profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the person's profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine, or the treating, operating, or prescribing for any health condition by a method, means, or procedure which the licensee refuses to divulge upon demand of the disciplining authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: The willful betrayal of a practitioner-patient privilege as recognized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation, threats, harassment, or financial inducements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation of facts before the disciplining authority or its authorized representative, or by the use of threats or harassment against any patient or witness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Current misuse of alcohol, controlled substances, or legend drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Current misuse of: (a) Alcohol; (b) Controlled substances; or (c) Legend drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abuse of a client or patient or sexual contact with a client or patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abuse of a client or patient or sexual contact with a client or patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acceptance of more than a nominal gratuity from a representative or vendor of medical products or services where a conflict of interest is presented.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acceptance of more than a nominal gratuity, hospitality, or subsidy offered by a representative or vendor of medical or health-related products or services intended for patients, in contemplation of a sale or for use in research publishable in professional journals, where a conflict of interest is presented

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing conversion therapy on a patient under age eighteen.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing conversion therapy on a patient under age eighteen

disciplinary_grounds.description: Implanting the license holder's own gametes or reproductive material into a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Implanting the license holder's own gametes or reproductive material into a patient.

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing medicine if he or she does one or more of the following: (1) Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality; (2) Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person; (3) Severs or penetrates the tissues of human beings; (4) Uses on cards, books, papers, signs, or other written or printed means of giving information to the public, in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the diagnosis or treatment of human disease or conditions the designation "doctor of medicine," "physician," "surgeon," "m.d.," or any combination thereof
definition_quote.quote: A person is practicing medicine if he or she does one or more of the following: (1) Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality; (2) Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person; (3) Severs or penetrates the tissues of human beings

value: advising on human disease or conditions
methods_authorized.quote: Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality

drug_authority.value: Physicians may administer or prescribe drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person; may prescribe controlled substances subject to drug law compliance.
drug_authority.quote: Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person

license_status_types.quote: The commission may, without examination, issue a limited license to persons who possess the qualifications set forth herein

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must: complete a resident course of professional instruction equivalent to US requirements; pass the ECFMG examination or equivalent; demonstrate English language proficiency; and meet all other requirements for US/Canadian graduates except graduation from a commission-approved school. An exceptional qualification waiver is available for those with outstanding research or medical excellence.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: That he or she has satisfactorily passed the examination given by the educational council for foreign medical graduates or has met the requirements in lieu thereof as set forth in rules adopted by the commission

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: That the applicant has completed two years of postgraduate medical training in a program acceptable to the commission

pain_management_education_required.quote: By June 30, 2011, the commission shall adopt new rules on chronic, noncancer pain management

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: By January 1, 2019, the commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs, which may contain exemptions based on education, training, amount of opioids prescribed, patient panel, and practice environment. Rules must also require physicians to inform patients of their right to refuse an opioid prescription.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: By January 1, 2019, the commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs. The rules may contain exemptions based on education, training, amount of opioids prescribed, patient panel, and practice environment.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Out-of-state practitioners may consult through telemedicine with a Washington-licensed practitioner who has responsibility for diagnosis and treatment; this is exempt from the licensing requirement. The interstate compact affirms that the practice of medicine occurs where the patient is located.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The consultation through telemedicine or other means by a practitioner, licensed by another state or territory in which he or she resides, with a practitioner licensed in this state who has responsibility for the diagnosis and treatment of the patient within this state

telemedicine_license_available.quote: The consultation through telemedicine or other means by a practitioner, licensed by another state or territory in which he or she resides, with a practitioner licensed in this state who has responsibility for the diagnosis and treatment of the patient within this state

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: In order to strengthen access to health care, and in recognition of the advances in the delivery of health care, the member states of the interstate medical licensure compact have allied in common purpose

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The practice of medicine by a licensed physician assistant which practice is performed under the supervision of or in collaboration with a physician licensed pursuant to this chapter

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A supervising physician may supervise no more than four license holders under this subsection unless the commission grants a request to increase this limit.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every institution or organization providing professional liability insurance to physicians shall send a complete report to the commission of all malpractice settlements, awards, or payments in excess of twenty thousand dollars

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every license holder, corporation, organization, health care facility, and state and local governmental agency that employs a license holder shall report to the disciplining authority when the employed license holder's services have been terminated or restricted

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The commission shall enter into a contract with the entity to implement a physician health program.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In investigating or adjudicating a complaint or report that a license holder may be unable to practice with reasonable skill or safety by reason of any mental or physical condition, the disciplining authority may require a license holder to submit to a mental or physical examination by one or more licensed or certified health professionals designated by the disciplining authority.

scope__license_status_types.quote: An individual licensed pursuant to chapter 18.71 RCW may place his or her license on inactive status. The holder of an inactive license shall not practice medicine and surgery in this state without first activating the license.
A physician who resides and practices in Washington and obtains or renews a retired active license shall be exempt from licensing fees imposed under this section.

If an individual licensed in another state that has licensing standards substantially equivalent to Washington applies for a license, the disciplining authority shall issue a temporary practice permit authorizing the applicant to practice the profession pending completion of documentation
Restriction or limitation of the practice
Compliance with conditions of probation for a designated period of time
Suspension of the license for a fixed or indefinite term
A surrender of the practitioner's license in lieu of other sanctions, which must be reported to the federal data bank.
the commission may issue a limited license to a physician applicant invited to serve as a teaching-research member of the institution's instructional staff

An individual credentialed by a disciplining authority regulated in the state under RCW 18.130.040, who is practicing only in emergent or intermittent circumstances as defined by rule established by the disciplining authority, may hold a retired active license
"Expedited license" means a full and unrestricted medical license granted by a member state to an eligible physician through the process set forth in the compact.

the commission may issue a limited license to a resident physician. Such license shall permit the resident physician to practice medicine only in connection with his or her duties as a resident physician
